signup.title: Create account
signup.closed: Registration is closed on this deployment. Ask an administrator for an invitation.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.confirmPrompt: Accept this invitation for your current account.
invite.signInPrompt: Sign in to accept this invitation.
invite.accepted: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used.
invite.missingToken: This link is missing its invitation token. Use the link from your invitation email.

device.title: Authorize this device
device.subtitle: Enter the code shown by the application requesting access.
device.confirmPrompt: Approving signs this device in as you. Only continue if you started this yourself.
device.approved: Device approved. You can return to the application.
device.denied: Request denied. The device was not signed in.
device.invalid: This code is not valid. It may have expired, or already been used.
device.missingCode: Enter the code the application is displaying.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.challengeSubtitle: Enter a code to finish signing in.
twoFactor.enabled: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabled: Add an authenticator app and one-time backup codes to protect your account.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code, save every backup code, then verify one authenticator code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for adding Agent Zero to an authenticator app
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Store these codes securely. Each code works once and will not be shown again.
twoFactor.error: The two-factor request failed. Check the password or code and try again.

errors.GENERIC: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and try again.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: That email and password combination is not valid.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with that email already exists.
errors.EMAIL_PASSWORD_SIGN_UP_DISABLED: Account creation is disabled on this deployment.
errors.INVITE_NOT_FOUND: That invitation could not be found.
errors.INVITE_ALREADY_USED: That invitation has already been used.
errors.INVITE_USES_EXHAUSTED: That invitation has reached its limit of uses.
errors.EMAIL_MISMATCH: That invitation was issued for a different email address.
errors.SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED: That organization has no seats left.
